entries.title: Genesis 34:1
segments: ¶Now Dinah the daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

entries.title: Genesis 34:2
segments: And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her and lay with her, and violated her.

entries.title: Genesis 34:3
segments: His soul was strongly attracted to Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young woman and spoke kindly to the young woman.

entries.title: Genesis 34:4
segments: So Shechem spoke to his father Hamor, saying, "Get me this young woman as a wife."

entries.title: Genesis 34:5
segments: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter. Now his sons were with his livestock in the field; so Jacob held his peace until they came.

entries.title: Genesis 34:6
segments: ¶Then Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to speak with him.

entries.title: Genesis 34:7
segments: And the sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard [it]; and the men were grieved and very angry, because he had done a disgraceful thing in Israel by lying with Jacob's daughter, a thing which ought not to be done.

entries.title: Genesis 34:8
segments: But Hamor spoke with them, saying, "The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

entries.title: Genesis 34:9
segments: "And make marriages with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters to yourselves.

entries.title: Genesis 34:10
segments: "So you shall dwell with us, and the land shall be before you. Dwell and trade in it, and acquire possessions for yourselves in it."

entries.title: Genesis 34:11
segments: Then Shechem said to her father and her brothers, "Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you say to me I will give.

entries.title: Genesis 34:12
segments: "Ask me ever so much dowry and gift, and I will give according to what you say to me; but give me the young woman as a wife."

entries.title: Genesis 34:13
segments: But the sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father, and spoke deceitfully, because he had defiled Dinah their sister.

entries.title: Genesis 34:14
segments: And they said to them, "We cannot do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised, for that [would be] a reproach to us.

entries.title: Genesis 34:15
segments: "But on this [condition] we will consent to you: If you will become as we [are], if every male of you is circumcised,

entries.title: Genesis 34:16
segments: "then we will give our daughters to you, and we will take your daughters to us; and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

entries.title: Genesis 34:17
segments: "But if you will not heed us and be circumcised, then we will take our daughter and be gone."

entries.title: Genesis 34:18
segments: ¶And their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor's son.

entries.title: Genesis 34:19
segments: So the young man did not delay to do the thing, because he delighted in Jacob's daughter. He [was] more honorable than all the household of his father.

entries.title: Genesis 34:20
segments: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke with the men of their city, saying:

entries.title: Genesis 34:21
segments: "These men [are] at peace with us. Therefore let them dwell in the land and trade in it. For indeed the land [is] large enough for them. Let us take their daughters to us as wives, and let us give them our daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 34:22
segments: "Only on this [condition] will the men consent to dwell with us, to be one people: if every male among us is circumcised as they [are] circumcised.

entries.title: Genesis 34:23
segments: "[Will] not their livestock, their property, and every animal of theirs [be] ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us."

entries.title: Genesis 34:24
segments: And all who went out of the gate of his city heeded Hamor and Shechem his son; every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

entries.title: Genesis 34:25
segments: ¶Now it came to pass on the third day, when they were in pain, that two of the sons of Jacob, Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, each took his sword and came boldly upon the city and killed all the males.

entries.title: Genesis 34:26
segments: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah from Shechem's house, and went out.

entries.title: Genesis 34:27
segments: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered the city, because their sister had been defiled.

entries.title: Genesis 34:28
segments: They took their sheep, their oxen, and their donkeys, what [was] in the city and what [was] in the field,

entries.title: Genesis 34:29
segments: and all their wealth. All their little ones and their wives they took captive; and they plundered even all that [was] in the houses.

entries.title: Genesis 34:30
segments: Then Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, "You have troubled me by making me obnoxious among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites; and since I [am] few in number, they will gather themselves together against me and kill me. I shall be destroyed, my household and I."

entries.title: Genesis 34:31
segments: But they said, "Should he treat our sister like a harlot?"
